clips.title: The story
paras: A Curious Pair begins when Trevan Rol notices an unusual duo passing through the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. Under the banner of the Earthen Ring, a tauren was seen traveling alongside a high elf—an alliance rare enough in Horde territory to prompt immediate suspicion.

The Sepulcher is a grim waystation where strangers are scrutinized carefully, especially those claiming diplomatic business. When two representatives purporting to belong to the Earthen Ring passed along the road, local scout Trevan Rol caught sight of them. While a tauren walking under the shamanic order's mantle surprised no one, his cloaked companion struck the Forsaken as exceedingly bizarre: an unmistakable high elf.

The presence of a quel'dorei traveling openly alongside a member of the Horde's shamanic circles naturally raises questions for the Forsaken sentries. The Earthen Ring typically concerns itself with the balance of the elements and rarely fields high elves in Lordaeron, let alone as companions to tauren envoys. To verify where this unusual pair went and what business they might have in the forest, travelers are directed to consult Deathguard Baldren at the edge of town.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Cutting straight to it, these "dignitaries" are no ordinary diplomats. One was a Tauren. Ordinary enough for the Earthen Ring, but the other--and you'll scarcely believe this--was an elf. A high elf. They were cloaked, but I've seen quel'dorei before and I'd bet my good pinky finger that's what I saw.
Why was an elf accompanying a Tauren through horde territory? Well, your guess is as good as mine. That's as much as I know, so I'd suggest speaking with Deathguard Baldren near the entrance to town.
